**Observation Log:**

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for creating contracts, including customizing templates, consulting with a lawyer, and regularly reviewing contracts.  
[EVENT] User is looking to finalize the contract for their marketing services.  
[USER] User needs help with clauses related to intellectual property and confidentiality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for the intellectual property (IP) clause, including defining IP ownership, specifying IP license, exclusions, and warranties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a sample IP clause for the user.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for the confidentiality clause, including defining confidential information, obligations, exceptions, and duration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a sample confidentiality clause for the user.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended resources for IP and confidentiality clauses, including the American Bar Association (ABA) Model Contract and International Trademark Association (INTA) Model Contract.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested using LegalZoom for contract templates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for writing specific clauses, including being specific, using definitions, seeking legal review, and being prepared to negotiate.
